title: Event Brief
description: Plan an event with a dedicated crew.

guide.intro: Turn an event brief into a coordinated plan with Riley, Dylan, Alex and Morgan.
points: Choose Plan an event and enter your audience, goals and event details.
Prepare the demo, then start the event plan. Riley coordinates the fixed crew's contributions.
Follow the team's progress and open the results to review demo ideas, staffing and the event webpage.
guide.note: Your event conversations and results stay saved when you switch spaces.

title: Open Task
description: Give Casey a task for your selected team.
team: Casey + your hires, with optional standby specialists

guide.intro: Give Casey a task for your selected team.
points: Hired only (default) uses your hires. Choose Hired + Standby to include backups.
Send /goal with the result you want. Name any agents to include and attach relevant files.
Track work in Mission Control, then open the answer and files in Results.
guide.note: Any hired role can participate. Remove /goal to chat directly with Casey.
